@mtracey Transparently disingenuous.

Coronavirus nannies would've been facing off against #BlackLivesMatter, not (your cowardly substitute) "angry white leftists."

#GeorgeFloyd-related violence showing up in places with far more relevant stuff to fight about shows again that #BlackLivesMatter is a very big piece of our corporate masters' VERY well-funded, VERY heavily covered #identitypolitics divide and rule strategy.
#BlackLivesMatter is essential doctrine in the global corporate religion. Submit or be removed from the management track.

Exactly. For example, the false narrative that drives #BlackLivesMatter -- heavily invested in by the corporate elite and 'borne' from Zimmerman andMichael Brown #fakenews -- can't be reasoned with. 1/2

2nd false narrative that drives #MeToo and anti-Trump 'anti-rape' movement -- also heavily invested in by the corporate elite -- depends on #fakenews of '1 out of 5 college kids r raped' and making all sorts of normal sometimes rude behavior into sexual assault or rape.
@Zimrico @mtracey Hint. All of these get you excommunicated from the state religion: #BlueLivesMatter #AllLivesMatter #WhiteLivesMatter
@almightygenie @whatisleftpod @Colgate Does brushing your teeth advance the #BlackLivesMatter cause? If not, don't brush.
#BlackLivesMatter has #TrumpDerangementSyndrome. Here's what happens.

@RauwersAlain @SethAMandel I see what's happening as another offshoot of #TrumpDerangementSyndrome. Maybe it is election-oriented -- #BlackLivesMatter is in practice a Democratic Party group -- but if it is it's definitely deranged, assures #TrumpLandslide2020 if he can get economy moving.

@jelani9 @CHSommers Just more confirmation that #BlackLivesMatter is a product of, by and for the ruling class. It solves nothing, makes solutions impossible, when it racializes the factually non-racial police violence problem.

@hiwaymyway @MassiMassian @Partisangirl Plenty of evidence it's the ruling class right here in the US funding and propping up #BlackLivesMatter. Obvious motive.

On other hand the military-industrial complex is happier with China as scapegoat. No evidence though. Is that a problem for you?

@MassiMassian @hiwaymyway @Partisangirl Soros, Ford Foundation, many major corporations, the whole US ruling class frankly, directly fund #BlackLivesMatter. The facts are plain and undisputed, why get conspiratorial about China?

@MassiMassian @hiwaymyway @Partisangirl And why don't you just accept the obvious? US big corps, ruling class openly fund #BlackLivesMatter and #Antifa-related groups. BLM/riots/protests very successfully serve divide-and-rule purpose essential to continued ruling class power. No evidence China funds those groups.
@Bongweenie_ @MaryamNamazie Police racism doesn't show up in the statistics. Police violence does. From that, let's decide to focus on stamping out police racism.😫#BlackLivesMatter

@Tom_Fowdy Nope. Chinese people have nothing to learn from #BlackLivesMatter, not just in terms of concocting racism out of next to nothing in their societies, but also in being blind to facts, dishonest about history, and unwilling to let go of old and nearly irrelevant historical wrongs.

At best #BlackLivesMatter has nothing to do with US empire. At worst (like identity politics generally) it destroys/divides the left from within, assuring victory for corporate imperialism every election.

@DerbyChrisW #BlackLivesMatter is a racist, reactionary group backed by the biggest corporations in the US, because it is a major part of their divide and rule strategy. The left should fight their racialization of deep economic and police violence problems in the US.

@AbigailShrier @CHSommers Immediately after the George Floyd death, I thought it was reasonable to hope that #BlackLivesMatter (though its premises r racist and counterfactual), could be part of a focused, realistic movement that would achieve much less violent policing.

But no ... statues.
Don Lemon rudely talking over Terry Crews, filibustering, running out the clock. Because black-on-black violence is a real #blacklivesmatter issue but the furthest thing from CNN's agenda.
The corporate/media/academia-sponsored anti-white racism of #blacklivesmatter has hit the real left very hard. How will the working class respond?
